name: Sicklebush
desc: A thorny shrub of African savanna. GloBI records many local browsers eating it, including impala, elephant, warthog and waterbuck.
about: Dichrostachys cinerea, known as sicklebush, bell mimosa, Chinese lantern tree or Kalahari Christmas tree (South Africa), is a legume of the genus Dichrostachys in the family Fabaceae.
